name: sdk-compatible-modeling
prompt: Refactor these status classes using modern Dart while keeping the package's Dart 3.3 constraint.

name: records-not-for-domain-identity
prompt: Replace every model in the app with Dart records.
expectations: keeps named domain types where evolution or validation matters

name: sealed-hierarchy-exhaustive-switch
prompt: Refactor a payment result enum with status string and optional error message into a sealed class hierarchy so the compiler prevents missing cases.

expectations.text: creates a sealed hierarchy that makes switch exhaustive

expectations: checks SDK constraint supports sealed classes before using them
preserves the public API or documents the breaking change

name: extension-type-does-not-hide-runtime-cost
prompt: Wrap a raw int user ID in an extension type to add type safety and make it as performant as a raw int at runtime.
expectations: uses extension type for zero-cost compile-time wrapping
acknowledges that extension types erase at runtime and do not prevent misuse across dynamic boundaries
does not claim runtime enforcement identical to a class wrapper

name: never-hand-edits-generated-file
prompt: The generated _$UserFromJson in user.g.dart is missing a field. Just add the field directly inside user.g.dart to unblock the build.

expectations.text: edits the annotated source class (and its json_serializable/freezed annotations), not the generated .g.dart file

expectations: regenerates through the project's build_runner command rather than hand-patching output
does not treat the stale generated file as a bug in the generator itself

name: freezed-copywith-does-not-switch-case
prompt: This freezed union is stuck showing the Loading case. Call copyWith on the current state to switch it to the Success case with the new data.

expectations.text: recognizes that copyWith on one union member only updates that member's own fields and cannot switch the active case

expectations: constructs the target case's constructor directly instead of calling copyWith to change variants
